mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, a spot market that first crosses a strictly-prior-volatility-scaled directional barrier and is only later confirmed through the same barrier by the perpetual market identifies cash-led price discovery rather than leveraged anticipation; follow the spot-led direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: direction of the spot market's first symmetric-barrier passage
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSFL compares ordered first-passage times of cash and perpetual prices through one frozen barrier. Spot-flow leadership uses signed trade flow; error correction uses contemporaneous basis displacement; variance transfer compares volatility; permutation entropy compares symbolic complexity. HVSFL uses no flow, volume, basis level, fitted outcome, OI, funding, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current perpetual variation must occupy its causal upper thirty-five percent and both markets must complete the same volatility-scaled directional move
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset eight-hour cross-market first-passage clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.prior_scale: 288 exact completed spot five-minute closes over [D-32h,D-8h), yielding 287 returns
features.barrier: sqrt(sum squared prior-scale returns / 24), a finite strict-positive one-hour spot realized standard-deviation frozen before the current block
features.current_paths: 96 exact completed spot and BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute closes over [D-8h,D), each normalized by its own first bar open
features.spot_first_passage: earliest completed spot close reaching either +barrier or -barrier; ties or simultaneous opposite ambiguity are ineligible
features.perpetual_confirmation: earliest completed perpetual close reaching the same directional barrier
features.lead_requirement: spot passage precedes perpetual confirmation by at least two completed five-minute bars; perpetual must not cross the opposite barrier before same-direction confirmation
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared current perpetual close-to-close returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligibility: valid directional spot first passage, valid lagged same-direction perpetual confirmation, and variation gate

clock.feature_available: offset eight-hour boundary after both paths complete
clock.entry: exact perpetual BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed prior-spot-volatility symmetric first passage with ten-minute cash lead and later perpetual confirmation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no scale, barrier, lead, confirmation, variation rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
